slate_menu.name: Slate UI
slate_menu.tablist.title: Players
slate_menu.options.menu.tab_list.tip: The list of players shown while Tab is held, drawn in Slate's look: the server's name and how many are on it, every player with their face, score and ping, your own row marked. It follows the style in use, whatever the layout. Off, the game draws its own list.
slate_menu.sort.name: Name
slate_menu.title.confirm_quit: Close Minecraft and return to the desktop?
slate_menu.title.nothing_yet_hint: Create a world or join a server to get started
slate_menu.worlds.empty_hint: Your singleplayer worlds will show up here.
slate_menu.worlds.select_one: Select a world to see its details
slate_menu.servers.invalid_address: That is not a valid server address
slate_menu.servers.sort.name: Name
slate_menu.servers.quick_connect_hint: Type an address to see its status, Enter to join
slate_menu.servers.empty_hint: Add a server below, or type an address above to connect directly.
slate_menu.pause.lan_open: This world is already open to LAN
slate_menu.pause.confirm_quit_sp: Save the world and return to the title screen?
slate_menu.options.open_hint: Opens the full vanilla settings page for this category.
slate_menu.options.difficulty_server: Difficulty is controlled by the server
slate_menu.options.slate_hint: Theme, accent, motion and the dev mode live in Slate settings.
slate_menu.options.menu.screens_hint: These only apply while Slate's custom layout is on (Slate settings). With the vanilla layout every vanilla screen stays.
slate_menu.options.menu.section.title: Title screen
Out of a world, what every menu stands on (in the panorama's place), blurred and dimmed the way the world is behind menus in a game: the loading screens' sky with its drifting motes, the main menu's scene (the one chosen below, without its chests and buttons), or the menus' own backgrounds.
slate_menu.options.menu.title_scene.tip: The world round the three chests of the Overhaul main menu. The arrows in the title screen's top right corner change it too.
slate_menu.options.menu.title_textures.t: How the Overhaul main menu's scene is painted. Mixed: Minecraft's own textures round Slate's painted chests. Default: Minecraft's own textures everywhere, real chests with oak signs on them. Stylized: the whole scene painted the way the chests are, in flat colours of a few tones.
slate_menu.options.menu.title_chests.tip: Off, the Overhaul main menu has no chests: its buttons are plain Slate buttons on a panel where the chests would be, with the same things in them.
slate_menu.options.menu.title_play_icon: Play button in the main menu
What stands for the Overhaul main menu's Play button. Grass block: a plain block that opens cave mouths when you point at it and shows the world inside it. Planet: the cube of world with clouds circling it.
slate_menu.overhaul.play_icon.block.desc: A plain grass block; pointed at, it opens and shows the world inside it.
slate_menu.overhaul.play_icon.planet.des: A cube of world with clouds circling it.
slate_menu.overhaul.style.mixed.desc: Minecraft's own textures round Slate's painted chests.
slate_menu.overhaul.style.default.desc: Minecraft's own textures everywhere, real chests included.
slate_menu.overhaul.style.stylized.desc: The whole scene painted the way the chests are.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.hint: Click, or use the arrow keys, to change the scene
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.hearth.desc: A log cabin on a winter night, the fire going in its stone chimney.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.workshop.desc: A Create workshop: a water wheel, a belt and a press, cogwheels, a steam engine and a windmill.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.library.desc: An enchanter's long hall: books to the rafters, candles and amethyst.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.redrose.desc: A great Gothic cathedral on its terrace above the gardens, in the evening light: Red rose city, by Dominic_de_Vos and team.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.rungholt.desc: A walled medieval town at nightfall, its lights coming on: kescha's Rungholt.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.skyfort.desc: An elven fortress on an island in the sky, its waterfalls pouring into the haze: by Mafia, Cloudax and Laoevpes.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.island.desc: Tall ships at anchor before a palace, a clock tower and a dome, in the afternoon sun: IsiAurinkoinen's European island city.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.port.desc: A medieval harbour town across its bay at the blue hour, its windows lit: ForgiaDeiBuilder's Medieval Port City.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.jar.desc: A Create workshop, belts and cogs at work: Joea42's build from createmod.com.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.windmill.desc: A giant Create windmill set into a snowy mountain: Uberswe's build from createmod.com.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.factory.desc: A brick factory of tall arched windows and three smokestacks: Icyknightgaming's build from createmod.com.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.missing: Its build is not here yet: the card under this gets it.
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.title: %s needs its build
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.body: %s's build from %s. The file is the author's, so Slate does not ship it.
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.broken: %s: its file could not be read
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.auto: Picked up by itself, whatever it is called: from Downloads, the scenes folder, or dropped onto this window.
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.watching: Watching Downloads for it. Or drop the file onto this window.
slate_menu.overhaul.fetch.not_a_build.bo: %s is none of the builds the scenes stand in.
slate_menu.overhaul.scene.classic.desc: The three chests on a dark floor, as the Overhaul main menu first was.

slate_menu.screenshots.sort.name: Name
slate_menu.screenshots.copy_unsupported: Clipboard images are not supported here
